melting point 175 °C: A semicrystalline bar cannot hold its shape above its melting point.

its own Vicat 92 °C + 5 °C: Vicat softening (a 10 N needle, 1 mm penetration) is reached at or above HDT at 0.45 MPa for an unfilled bar; the highest Vicat the material's own grades publish caps its unfilled heat deflection estimate softly (BVOH's estimate reached 158 °C against its own Vicat of 90 °C). No melting-point margin is applied below the melting point itself: PVDF publishes 158 °C, 12 °C under its melting point.
glass transition 68.5 °C + 10 °C: An amorphous matrix softens at its glass transition; fibres carry a bar only a little further.

rows: When the surface appearance of your part is paramount, BigRep BVOH results in better surface quality with less postprocessing effort.
BigRep's BVOH support material is a water-soluble filament that drastically reduces post-processing for 3D printed parts.
Created for use with dual-extruder printers, BigRep BVOH is compatible with a wide range of materials to provide efficient support during the printing process.
BVOH is ideal when 3D printing complex geometries where breakaway support be difficult to remove or impossible to access a昀琀er printing.
BVOH easily dissolves in water, cleanly freeing parts from support structures without manual post-processing.
While the dissolving time depends on part geometry and slicing settings, BVOHís solubility increases with higher water temperature and delivers faster results.
Use the BigRep Keep-Dry Box for best material printability.
Protect from moisture and keep unused filament tightly closed.
Recommended: ASA, PLX ï Conditional: PLA, PRO HT, HI-TEMP, HI-TEMP CF, TPU 98A Results depend on part size and geometry.
Water soluble support material | easy to print
Ultrafuse® BVOH can show softening effects in environments >60°C. Ensure a proper filament cooling before the filament enters the nozzle to avoid extrusion issues.

polymerEnvironment.finding: The first of its kind water soluble, biodegradable, extrudable, and reactive vinyl alcohol resin. Applications include biodegradable/compostable gas barrier packaging, oil and gas drilling, water-soluble extrusions and molding, and dispersants.
polymerEnvironment.notes: Nichigo G-Polymer is the butenediol vinyl alcohol copolymer behind BVOH support filaments; Kuraray Mowiflex (suggested for BVOH in the brief) is a polyvinyl alcohol product per its own TDS and is recorded under PVA instead.
